instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Environmental conservation foundation managing 15 protected area and habitat restoration projects covering 25,000 hectares. Aether Services blends rigorous scientific research, on-the-ground community engagement, and advocacy to protect biodiversity hotspots. Annual budget of €4M from grants and individual donations, the organization currently uses advanced geospatial technology like satellite monitoring for real-time deforestation alerts.
answers.pastInitiatives: We attempted to introduce a weekly innovation brainstorming session across departments, but attendance dropped rapidly after the first month. Participants felt the sessions generated interesting ideas but had no clear path to execution or budget. The initiative faded without producing any tangible outcome.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Current funding cycles are highly restrictive and prioritize grant compliance over exploration. Our core operational teams are experts in ecology but lack formalized business development or market entry expertise, creating a gap for scalable growth.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: B2B Geospatial Data Monetization Platform
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the existing satellite monitoring and AI capabilities to package aggregated, anonymized environmental data into a high-value subscription service for private sector entities such as carbon credit brokers or infrastructure developers. This shifts the revenue model from project-based grants/donations to recurring, scalable B2B sales.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on data anonymization and licensing frameworks.
Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) demonstrating data visualization capabilities for potential corporate clients.
resources_needed: Data scientist consultant specializing in geospatial APIs
Initial legal consultation on data monetization contracts
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 pilot B2B subscription agreements within the short time horizon.
milestones: Q1: Finalize technical specifications for B2B platform features.
Q2: Launch paid pilot program with one corporate partner.

opportunities.title: Tiered Community Engagement Subscription
opportunities.rationale: Introduce a tiered subscription service for local community groups offering premium access to ecological insights, personalized conservation action plans, and tailored educational workshops. This diversifies the customer base away from pure grant funding while increasing recurring revenue.

first_actions: Interview community leaders regarding willingness to pay for specialized ecosystem services.
Design a simple tiered feature roadmap (Basic/Pro/Advocate).
resources_needed: Training for existing operations staff on service delivery.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 25% conversion rate from current grant beneficiaries to paying subscribers.
milestones: Month 1: Finalize pricing tiers and feature sets.
Month 3: Soft launch of the 'Pro' tier.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated cross-functional task force (Tech, Ops, Strategy) to define the market size and regulatory landscape for B2B data services.
Allocate seed funding from the 'bold' risk budget to initiate a rapid prototyping phase for the B2B data monetization MVP.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized business development and market entry expertise within the operational teams.
Informal innovation process leading to ideas without clear execution paths or budget allocation.
High dependency on a single product category and revenue stream, posing significant concentration risk.
